name: Boon of Bones
body:
Slashing and piercing weapons easily slip harmlessly between your bones.

Prerequisite: Obitu, Character level 5.

Benefit: You gain Damage Reduction 1 / bludgeoning.

Special: You can take this feat multiple times, adding an additional point of DR each time.
